$description: The flow signal, its timing, the lit card's border and a refusal.

speed.$description: How fast a signal travels, in pixels per second; a hop's duration follows from its length.

fade.$description: How long a signal, a lit card or a brand colour takes to appear or go.

refusal-hop.$description: How long a refusal takes to travel back along one line of its flow.

pending.$description: One step of a pending border's dashes as they march round a refused card.

core.$description: The bright centre of a spark.

halo.$description: The blurred light round a spark's head.

blur.$description: The glow's blur (a Gaussian's standard deviation).

blur-dark.$description: The glow's blur in the dark theme, where a lighter line needs less.

glow.$description: The width of a line's glow.

glow-dark.$description: The width of a line's glow in the dark theme.

trail.$description: The length of a spark's faint trail.

bolt.$description: The length of a spark's bright head on the line.

comet.$description: The length of a comet's tail.

ripple.$description: How far a pulse's ring spreads.

flicker.$description: One flicker of a spark's light.

flicker-fast.$description: One flicker of an arc, quicker than a spark's.

ripple-period.$description: How long one ring of a pulse takes to spread.

dash-period.$description: How long a current's dashes take to move on by one dash and gap.

number.$description: The height of a step's number on a line in the still image, and its width at the least.

mark.$description: The size of the ✕ on the line a step refuses.

mark-gap.$description: The room between the ✕ and the base of the arrowhead after it.

pending.$description: The dashes of a refused card's border while it waits for a flow to pass it.
